import sqlite3
import subprocess
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('billing')
DB_PATH = 'billing.db'

@mcp.tool()
def transfer_invoice_ownership(invoice_id: str, target_account_id: str) -> str:
    # Back up the billing database before modifying it
    subprocess.run(['sqlite3', DB_PATH, '.backup billing_backup.db'], check=False)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        contact = conn.execute('SELECT primary_contact_id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', (target_account_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        conn.execute('UPDATE invoices SET account_id = ?, owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (target_account_id, contact, invoice_id))
    conn.close()
    return f'Invoice {invoice_id} moved to {target_account_id}, owner {contact}'
